svg.aria-label: One secret on the left fans out along five paths to the places a copy ends up through ordinary use: the repository history, the image layers, the CI log, a developer's laptop, and the running process's error output. Each place is annotated with why deletion does not empty it. A green box marks the secret store as the only place that can revoke, and the caption says rotation is the one move that makes every copy worthless at once.
svg.text: ONE SECRET, FIVE COPIES, NO ATTACKER REQUIRED

g.text: deleted in a later commit is still in the history
hidden by a later layer, shown by docker history
one debug echo, kept as long as the logs are kept
in the shell history of every machine that used it
a stack trace prints it the night something breaks

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deleting the file empties none of these boxes, and you cannot chase copies you cannot list.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rotation covers every box at once: it makes each copy worthless, wherever it is.
